## Review

<!-- Tick what you actually did. The levels build on each other; the check derives
     your Human-Review and AI-Review levels from the ticks. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

Human review (at least H0 is required):
- [ ] **H0** I checked the result as a whole: it does what was asked, runs, and the output is plausible
- [ ] **H1** I ran the tests or reproduced the key results myself, and read the important parts
- [ ] **H2** I read every changed line, understand it, and checked edge cases
- [ ] **H3** I validated it independently: new tests, a reference solution or method, or a second person's review

AI review (leave all unticked for A-; required for AI-written changes):
- [ ] **A0** An AI checked the change: it ran the tests and reviewed the result
- [ ] **A1** … in a fresh session without the generating conversation
- [ ] **A2** … using a different model of similar or higher capability
- [ ] **A3** … with a full benchmark: new tests and comparison with reference methods or solutions
